title: BUG-007 reopened: asked for overdue cases, Jarvis says there are none
what_happens: "overdue cases this week" says "There are no cases this week for this view." and shows "No incidents match this view." The console's list has 339 past deadline this week, the same as the oracle (console equals the oracle in 100 of 100 scopes), and Ask District IQ says 339. Today 11, 30 days 742, 90 days 888: all said as none. On a second run 20 of 20 no-severity scopes with overdue cases say none; an earlier, wider sweep had 44 of 56.
what_should_happen: The overdue cases of the scope are listed, and the total is the console's count.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/audit-narrate_and_figures.test.ts -t AUD-NF-1; or type "overdue cases this week" in the Jarvis bar
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/screens.ts:414-417: asks the tool for status open, page 0, sorted by severity, then keeps the overdue rows of that one page. The page is 12 rows and Low first (AUD-NF-4), so none are overdue, and :450 says none. list() already has an overdue status (intel.ts, route's STATUSES), but tools.ts:392 LIST_STATUSES leaves it out.
class: a figure taken from one page of a list; a test on a fake tool that hid it

title: BUG-021 partly: severe overdue counts differ from the console, and High overdue says none

what_happens: "இந்த வாரம் எத்தனை சம்பவங்கள்" (how many incidents this week) says "இதற்குப் பொருந்தும் சம்பவங்களோ செய்திகளோ இல்லை." (no incidents or news match), where English and Tanglish say 1,357. "நேற்றைய புகார்கள் எத்தனை" answers the last 24 hours (147). "நேத்து எவ்வளவு புகார்" answers 90 days (9,113). "how many were resolved yesterday" and "how many deaths yesterday" give "In the previous day (yesterday): 9 severe events, 147 open citizen complaints, 236 ongoing incidents, 3 resolved this day.", which are the last 24 hours' tiles under the wrong name.

repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/audit-narrate_and_figures.test.ts -t AUD-NF-15; the first sentence is in the real-run log only

These ran with no model key, so a router would catch some of them when a model answers; that was not tested in this phase. detectIntent's OVERDUE (src/lib/assistant/intent.ts:203) has no Tamil words, and the rules' lane does not read சம்பவங்கள் as a count. All of this is the no-model path, in a worktree whose meaning search cannot load (AUD-NF-21): it is what a user gets when the model is out, not a normal day; a model answer was not tested in this phase.
